cover.title: TimescaleDB Design System
cover.categories: Design System, Visual Design, UI, UX

header: In high stakes industries like oil refining, a single sensor anomaly can lead to environmental disaster or mechanical failure. But using time series data can reveal patterns and predict failures before they happen. It provides the clarity needed to monitor infrastructure and prevent a crisis before it starts.
seo_description: Senior Product Design Case Study: Translating complex database architecture into human centered design systems and real time visual narratives.

text: This demo was built to highlight the power of time series data in a professional setting. By pulling a live feed from real world sensors into a dedicated database I created an interface that simplifies complexity. It turns a wall of technical readings into a clear view that a person can read at a glance while making dense information feel clear and intuitive.
